top_signal.title: Changes made by Elon Musk and his DOGE bros to the Small Business Administration, including changes to the EIDL and PPP Loans meant to help businesses severely impacted by the COVID-19 epidemic.
top_signal.summary: I have created a document describing the changes made to the Small Business Administration by Elon Musk and his DOGE Bros — from the broader DOGE reorganization, database controversies, and lending rule changes down to the specific EIDL servicing center layoffs, hardship cuts, and Treasury collection policies.    What DOGE and the SBA Reorganization Did to the Agency and EIDL Borrowers (2025–2026 Overview)    Here is a complete breakdown of the operational overhauls, staffing cuts, database controversies, lending rule changes, and customer service impacts across the Small Business Administration (SBA)—and specifically the COVID-19 Economic Injury Disaster Loan (EIDL) portfolio—during the 2025–2026 DOGE-aligned reorganization.    Part 1: Agency-Wide Overhauls & Controversies     1. Mass Workforce Reductions & Reorganization     43%+ Overall Staff Cut:  According to reporting from the  Associated Press  and  CBS News , SBA Administrator Kelly Loeffler announced in March 2025 that the agency would eliminate roughly 2,700 jobs—representing 43% of its workforce—as part of a DOGE-aligned reorganization. By the time the SBA released its FY 2025 Annual Report, overall staff reductions had exceeded 50%.    Office Closures & Lease Terminations:  Public data and summaries of DOGE’s agency actions documented the termination of over two dozen office leases and dozens of agency contracts.
